512-1606-5475.easyPrerequisites: Ley Weaver and Forensic Researcher do not have summoning sickness.
512-1606-5475.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two mana-producing lands that can collectively tap to produce {W}{W}.
512-1606-5475.description:
Activate two lands by tapping them, adding at least {W}{W}.
Activate Ley Weaver by tapping it, untapping the two lands.
Activate Forensic Researcher by tapping it, targeting Halo Fountain.
Holding priority, activate Halo Fountain by paying {W}{W}, tapping it, and untapping Forensic Researcher and Ley Weaver, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Forensic Researcher ability, untapping Halo Fountain.
Repeat.

529-3480-4186-8181.description:
Activate a creature by tapping it, causing you to surveil 1.
Denzilore triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a creature token.
Repeat.

2511-2577-5478-7084.easyPrerequisites:
You control another Zombie.
You control a land that can tap to produce at least {B}.
2511-2577-5478-7084.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Gravecrawler.
When Gravecrawler dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land that can tap to produce at least {B}.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to Spelunking.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Activate the land by tapping it, adding at least {B}.
Cast Gravecrawler from your graveyard by paying {B}.
Repeat.
2511-2577-5478-7084.notes: An infinite card draw result has been added to this combo due to Cultivator Colossus or a similar card. This likely limits the other results based on the number of cards in your library.

uses.n: Budoka Gardener // Dokai, Weaver of Life

1993-5621-7857.easyPrerequisites: You control eight or fewer lands.
1993-5621-7857.description:
Activate Budoka Gardener // Dokai, Weaver of Life by tapping it, putting Arid Archway from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Arid Archway enters the battlefield, it and Elven Raft-Steerer trigger.
Resolve the Arid Archway trigger, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Elven Raft-Steerer trigger, untapping Budoka Gardener // Dokai, Weaver of Life.
Repeat.

81-2021-2060-3129.description:
Activate Simic Ascendancy by paying {1}{G}{U}, putting four +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler.
Simic Ascendancy triggers, putting growth counters on it.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's second ability by removing three +1/+1 counters from it, adding {1}{G}{U}.
Repeat.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Simic Ascendancy triggers, causing you to win the game.

3617-6991-7370.description:
Cast Time Walk by paying its mana cost.
Kykar triggers, exiling Donnie & April.
Resolve Time Walk, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your end step, Kykar triggers, returning Donnie & April from exile to the battlefield.
When Donnie & April enters, it triggers, returning Time Walk from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat each turn.

215-4359-5457.notablePrerequisites: You control at least seven creatures with different powers.
215-4359-5457.description:
Activate Selvala by tapping it, adding an amount of {G} or {W}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Selvala from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Selvala by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.
215-4359-5457.notes: Alternate the colors of mana you add each time. If you start adding {W}, you need {G} for Temur Sabertooth and {G} to cast Selvala

643-4508-7746.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to cause an artifact to enter the battlefield under your control.
643-4508-7746.description:
Cause an artifact to enter the battlefield under your control.
HYDRA Assault Robot triggers, dealing 1 damage to target opponent.
Malcolm triggers, as HYDRA Assault Robot is a Pirate due to Maskwood Nexus, creating a Treasure token
When the Treasure enters, HYDRA Assault Robot triggers, dealing 1 damage to target opponent.
Repeat from step 3.

uses.n: Etali, Primal Conqueror // Etali, Primal Sickness

575-4294-5686-7115.description:
Cast Etali by paying {5}{R}{R}
When Etali enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Etali.
When Etali dies, Yedora triggers, returning Etali from your graveyard to the battlefield face-down as a Forest land.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Holding priority, activate Etali by tapping it, adding {G}.
Resolve the Etali trigger from step 2, exiling cards from the top of each library until each player has exiled a nonland card, and causing you to cast any number of those cards without paying its mana cost.
For each card cast, Toph's second ability triggers once.
Resolve the first Toph trigger, earthbending Etali.
Resolve any remaining triggers, earthbending any other lands you desire. If you do not want to earthbend other lands, target Etali with all remaining triggers.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Etali.
When Etali dies, Toph and Yedora trigger.
Resolve the Yedora trigger, choosing not to return Etali.
Resolve the Toph trigger, returning Etali from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Repeat from step 2.
Resolve all Shilgengar abilities from step 11.

4365-4682-7132.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot pay for Smothering Tithe's trigger more than once.
4365-4682-7132.description:
Activate Super-Skrull's fourth ability by paying {5}{U}, causing an opponent to draw four cards.
Smothering Tithe triggers four times, causing you to create two Treasure tokens for each time the opponent cannot pay for the trigger.
Activate six Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {5}{U}.
Repeat.
4365-4682-7132.notes:
If the opponent can pay for Smothering Tithe's trigger more times, you can still perform the combo if you have enough mana to outlast their mana supply. You can also continue this combo for other opponents if mana allows.
The extra mana can be used to activate any of Super-Skrull's abilities.

1558-1671-2638-4231-4772.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
1558-1671-2638-4231-4772.description:
Play Simic Growth Chamber.
When Simic Growth Chamber enters, it and Tireless Tracker trigger
Resolve the Simic Growth Chamber trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Tireless Tracker trigger, creating two Treasure, two Clue and two Food artifact tokens due to Academy Manufactor and Doubling Season.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it and sacrificing five of the artifact tokens, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

2060-2092-5140-7315.description:
Activate Kenrith by paying {G}, putting two +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler.
Activate Crystalline Crawler by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {G}.
Repeat.
2060-2092-5140-7315.notes:
You may place additional counters on Crystalline Crawler to get infinite mana, and then use that mana to activate Kenrith's abilities.
Once you have infinite mana, you may spend it on Kenrith's other abilities.

uses.n: The Enigma Jewel // Locus of Enlightenment

74-2043-6311-7292.description:
Activate Urza by paying {6}, targeting Radiant Lotus.
Locus of Enlightenment triggers, copying Urza's ability, targeting Radiant Lotus.
Resolve both Urza abilities, creating two token copies of Radiant Lotus that are 1/1 Soldier artifact creatures.
Activate a Radiant Lotus token by tapping it and sacrificing both Radiant Lotus tokens, targeting yourself.
Locus of Enlightenment triggers, copying the Radiant Lotus token's ability, targeting yourself.
Resolve both Radiant Lotus abilities, adding twelve mana of any color.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it

1563-2079-3129-3899.description:
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by paying {1} and removing two charge counters from it, creating two creature tokens
Activate the tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability twice by sacrificing the tokens, putting two charge counters on Spawning Pit.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it

304-539-3334-3899-4552.description:
Animate Spawning Pit using Tough Cookie
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by removing two charge counters from it due to Blossoming Tortoise, creating a 2/2 Spawn artifact creature token.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability by sacrificing the Spawn, putting two charge counters on it.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

2044-3967-6972.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Peema Outrider.
When Peema Outrider dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Peema Outrider enters, its fabricate ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat.

1753-4153-6575--136.description:
Activate Terra, Magical Adept by paying {4}{R}{G} and tapping it, exiling it and returning it to the battlefield as Esper Terra.
When Esper Terra enters the battlefield, its first chapter ability triggers, copying another nonlegendary Saga you control and putting two to three lore counters on it.
The Saga tokens first through fourth chapter abilities trigger, as applicable. Resolve all triggers, and sacrifice the Saga token upon resolving the final trigger.
When the Saga token leaves the battlefield, Resourceful Defense triggers, moving the lore counters from the Saga token onto Esper Terra.
Esper Terra's second, third and fourth chapter abilities trigger.
Resolve the second and third chapter abilities.
Resolve the fourth chapter ability, adding {W}{W}{U}{U}{B}{B}{R}{R}{G}{G} and then exiling Esper Terra and returning it to the battlefield as Terra, Magical Adept.
Resourceful Defense and Terra, Magical Adept trigger.
Resolve the Resourceful Defense trigger, moving all counters from Esper Terra onto any other permanent
Resolve the Terra, Magical Adept trigger, causing you to mill five cards and return up to one enchantment card from among them from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
1753-4153-6575--136.notes: The chosen Saga must have no more than four chapter abilities. Once you have infinite white mana, you can instead copy any other permanent besides the chosen Saga, and move counters to and from Esper Terra using Resourceful Defense's ability.

132-3053-5200.notablePrerequisites: There are at least four basic land types among lands you control
132-3053-5200.description:
Activate Myr Welder using Prismatic Geoscope's ability by tapping it, adding at least {4}.
Activate Sword of the Paruns by paying {3}, untapping Myr Welder.
Repeat.
132-3053-5200.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may attach Sword of the Paruns to any other creature(s) to untap them.

1563-2079-2457-6705.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two creature tokens.
Activate the tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat

643-703-2034-4394.description:
Cast Everquill Phoenix for its mutate cost by paying {3}{R}, mutating it over or under a non-Human creature you control.
Everquill Phoenix triggers, creating a Feather artifact token.
Cast Astral Dragon by paying {6}{U}{U}.
When Astral Dragon enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating two copies of the Feather token that are 3/3 Dragon creatures.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Astral Dragon, adding {C}{C}.
Activate a Feather by paying {1} and sacrificing it, returning Astral Dragon from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 4.

341-1690-2538-2585.notablePrerequisites: You have an artifact card in hand that can be cast for {0} due to Umori.
341-1690-2538-2585.description:
Activate Grim Monolith by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Words of Wind by paying {1}.
Cast an artifact by paying {0}.
Jhoira triggers, causing each player to return a permanent they control from the battlefield to their hand due to Words of Wind, with you returning Grim Monolith to your hand.
Activate Words of Wind by paying {1}.
Cast Grim Monolith by paying its mana cost reduced by {1}.
Jhoira triggers, causing each player to return a permanent they control from the battlefield to their hand due to Words of Wind, with you returning the artifact cast in step 3 to your hand.
Repeat.
341-1690-2538-2585.notes: You can use a historic creature to get infinite ETB and LTB triggers. If you do not use a creature, this combo will not produce those results.

1812-4222-4893-5516.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent controls a creature.
Red Death does not have summoning sickness.
Freed from the Real attached to Red Death.
1812-4222-4893-5516.description:
Activate Red Death by tapping it, adding {R}, goading a creature an opponent controls and causing that opponent to draw a card.
Activate Prismite by paying {1}, adding {U}.
Activate Freed from the Real by paying {U}, untapping Red Death.
Repeat.

2713-4499-5418.description:
Activate Emiel the Blessed by paying {1}, blinking Exhibition Magician.
When Exhibition Magician enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

851-3389-4050-5043.description:
Cast Flickering Ward by paying {W}, targeting any creature you control.
Alela triggers, creating two 1/1 Faerie creature tokens with flying.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing both Faerie tokens, adding {W}{W}.
Activate Flickering Ward by paying {W}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

1339-2034-3594-4013.notablePrerequisites: Toothy has at least two +1/+1 counters on it.
1339-2034-3594-4013.description:
Activate Eldrazi Displacer by paying {2}{C}, blinking Toothy.
When Toothy leaves and enters the battlefield, its second ability triggers, causing you to draw at least two cards.
Toothy's first ability and The Locust God trigger for each card drawn.
Resolve all Toothy triggers, putting that many +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve all Locust God triggers, creating that many 1/1 Insect creature tokens with flying and haste.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing two Insects, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Repeat.

3062-3933-4929-5479.notablePrerequisites:
Lost Jitte has at least one charge counter on it.
Cryptic Trilobite has at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
3062-3933-4929-5479.description:
Activate Karn's Bastion by paying {4}, putting two charge counters on Lost Jitte and two +1/+1 counters on Cryptic Trilobite.
Activate Cryptic Trilobite's first ability twice by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, adding {C}{C}{C}{C} that can only be spent to activate abilities.
Activate Lost Jitte by removing a charge counter from it, untapping Karn's Bastion.
Repeat.

824-2464-4772.notablePrerequisites:
Leech Bonder does not have summoning sickness.
Song of Freyalise has exactly one or two lore counters on it.
824-2464-4772.description:
Activate Leech Bonder by tapping it, adding {U}.
Activate Leech Bonder by paying {U} and untapping it, removing a +1/+1 counter from target creature and putting two +1/+1 counters on a different creature due to Doubling Season.
Repeat.

1528-3014-5195.notablePrerequisites: Dual Casting attached to a creature without summoning sickness.
1528-3014-5195.description:
Cast Emerald Charm by paying {G}, targeting any permanent.
Storm-Kiln Artist triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {R}.
Activate the creature with Dual Casting attached by paying {R} and tapping it, copying Emerald Charm, targeting the creature with Dual Casting attached.
Storm-Kiln Artist triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the copy of Emerald Charm, untapping the creature with Dual Casting attached.
Repeat from step 3.

1560-2029-2340-3953.notablePrerequisites: Your life total is at least three.
1560-2029-2340-3953.description:
Activate Unbridled Growth by sacrificing it.
Mazzy triggers, exiling Unbridled Growth and allowing you to cast it from exile until the end of your next turn.
Resolve the Unbridled Growth ability, causing you to draw a card.
Cast Unbridled Growth from exile by paying 2 life.
Student of Ojutai and Defiler of Vigor trigger.
Resolve the Defiler of Vigor trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Resolve the Student of Ojutai trigger, causing you to gain two life.
Resolve Unbridled Growth, attaching it to any land you control.
Repeat.

3055-3149-3747-4050.notablePrerequisites: Gift of Immortality attached to Child of Alara.
3055-3149-3747-4050.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Child of Alara, adding one mana of any color.
Child of Alara dies, triggering itself and Gift of Immortality.
Resolve the Child of Alara trigger, destroying all nonland permanents you don't control due to your permanents having indestructible.
Resolve the Gift of Immortality trigger, returning Child of Alara from your graveyard to the battlefield.
At the beginning of the next end step, Gift of Immortality triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Child of Alara.
Repeat each turn.

461-4141-4475.description:
Activate Zevlor by paying {2} and tapping it, causing you to copy the next spell you cast this turn that targets a single opponent for each other opponent.
Cast Blood Tribute with kicker by paying {4}{B}{B} and tapping a Vampire you control, targeting any opponent.
Zevlor triggers, copying Peer into the Abyss for each opponent.
Resolve each Peer into the Abyss, causing each opponent to lose half their life total, rounded up, and you to gain life equal to the life lost this way.
At the beginning of your end step, Wound Reflection triggers, causing each opponent to lose life equal to the life they lost this turn.
Each opponent loses the game due to having zero or less life.

1159-3041-5109.description:
Cast Volcano Hellion by paying {2}{R}{R}.
Volcano Hellion enters the battlefield, triggering itself, dealing an arbitrarily large amount of damage to Coalhauler Swine and to you, which does not reduce your life total below 1 due to Sustaining Spirit.
Coalhauler Swine triggers, dealing an equal amount of damage to each player, which again does not reduce your life total below 1.
